slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a Greek island wedding setting that signals luxury and sets up a practical how-to guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2, room for a title overlay. Ceremony set-up on a sea-view terrace or clifftop at a real, named Greek island venue (Cycladic whitewash or Ionian green), late afternoon light, calm sea, white florals and olive branches, no signage. Couple optional and small in frame. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. Source: the venue's own media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent), or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by the media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance.
